pages.title: A braced Echo Shatter
text: The Shatter Array is an optional brace for your [Echo Shatter](echo_shatter). Centre the station in a five by five, stand a totem at each corner, and set an Ancestral Cache directly beneath it.
In return the station spends **a quarter less Pulse** and empties its output straight into the cache below.
It is entirely optional: the station works exactly as before without it.

pages.title: The array
pages.text: Four totems on the corners, two blocks out on the diagonals, and the cache under the station.

pages.title: Getting it right
text: All four corner totems must be the voice of the recipe the station is running. For shards from stone that is **Earth**. A wrong voice at any corner simply means no discount.
The array is drawn around the Echo Shatter only; the other Echo stations do not take it.
A redstone signal on the cache stops the emptying. Crouch and right-click the station with the Codex to see ghosts and whether it counts as arrayed.
